# wattray

> Free, open source Windows tray app that shows the battery level of wireless peripherals: one tray icon per device, with a glyph for the device type and the battery percentage.

- Download: https://github.com/facuga7van/wattray/releases/latest/download/wattray.exe (single ~300 KB exe, no installer, Windows 10 and 11)
- Source and docs: https://github.com/facuga7van/wattray (Rust, MIT license)
- Supported: Logitech HID++ (Lightspeed, Unifying, Bolt), SteelSeries Arctis headsets, Bluetooth devices with a battery in Windows Settings, Corsair headsets, HyperX headsets, Razer wireless mice and keyboards, SteelSeries Aerox / Prime / Rival 3 wireless mice, Corsair Slipstream mice, HyperX Cloud III and Pulsefire mice, budget mice on CompX receivers (Pulsar, VXE, ATK, LAMZU, VGN, Scyrox), Glorious Model O/D Wireless, any dongle that reports its battery the standard HID way, and anything Logitech G HUB shows a battery for while it runs.
- Colors: white above 20 %, amber at 20 % or less, red at 10 % or less, green while charging, F when full.
- Uninstall: run `wattray.exe --uninstall`, then delete the exe.
